senses.gloss:
बुभुत्सा, f. (fr. the Desid.), wish to become
acquainted with, desire to know, curiosity.

बुभुत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to know, eager to
learn, desirous of knowing all things (said of the
gods); curious.

बुभुक्षा बुभुक्षा, f. (fr. the Desid. of rt.
भुज्), desire of eating, appetite, hunger; the desire
of enjoying anything.
—बुभुक्षापनय (˚षा-
अप्˚), अस्, m. ‘that which takes away hunger,’ food.
—बुभुक्षा-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, pained by hunger.

बुभुक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, hungered, hungry, starv-
ing, pinched with hunger, famishing, ravenous.

बुभुक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or longing to eat,
hungry; longing to enjoy (with acc.), desirous of
enjoyment; (opposed to मुमुक्षु, q. v.)

बुभूर्षु बुभूर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt.
भृ), wishing to nourish, desirous of supporting.

बुभूषक बुभूषक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Desid.
of rt. 1. भू), wishing to become, desiring to be of
service (to another).

बुभूषा, f. wish to become, desire of being or
living.

बुभूषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to become, de-
sirous of being; wishing to become powerful or to
prevail; desiring to be of service (to another).
